audit.skip_reason: No specialist reports present — services not verified or not run this cycle

escalations.title: Handlebars 4.7.8 — Remote Code Execution via AST Injection
escalations.description: Handlebars is vulnerable to Prototype Pollution and AST injection that can lead to RCE when user-controlled input reaches a Handlebars template. CVSS 9.8 Critical.
escalations.recommendation: Identify usage — if used for email/templates, upgrade or remove. Pin to patched version. Do not allow user input into template compilation.

escalations.title: Vitest 3.2.5 — Arbitrary File Read / RCE when UI exposed
escalations.description: Vitest browser UI exposes an endpoint that allows arbitrary file reads from the test runner host when the UI is accessible. In CI/CD or misconfigured dev environments this can escalate to RCE. CVSS 9.8 Critical.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade to vitest 3.2.6+ (or 4.x). Never expose the Vitest UI port outside localhost. Verify CI build images do not expose the port externally.

escalations.title: Protobufjs 7.6.4 — Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: Protobufjs has a prototype pollution vulnerability exploitable through malformed .proto definitions or message data, enabling arbitrary code execution. CVSS 9.8 Critical. This is on the gRPC critical path.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade protobufjs to 7.7.0+. Validate all .proto sources are trusted. Run gRPC integration tests after upgrade.

p1_findings.title: Primary spec entirely untraced — dev-workflow-platform.md (FR-001–069)
p1_findings.description: The implementation is a Work Item routing/assessment engine (FR-WF-XXX) but the governing spec defines a completely different product (Feature Requests, Bug Reports, Dev Cycles). Not one '// Verifies: FR-0XX' comment exists in Source/. Either the spec must be archived or 69 FRs are abandoned work.
p1_findings.recommendation: requirements-reviewer must reconcile: archive dev-workflow-platform.md or write a migration plan aligning source to it.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — false PASSED signal
p1_findings.description: The enforcer only scans the most-recently-modified Plans/*/requirements.md. The entire Specifications/ directory is excluded. Running the gate produces TRACEABILITY PASSED while 69 primary-spec FRs are completely untraced.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan against Specifications/workflow-engine.md (or the canonical primary spec). Add a second gate or update the enforcer's scan targets.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search — tested but not implemented, causes known CI failures
p1_findings.description: Test file explicitly states the route is NOT wired into app.ts and will FAIL until implemented. The test suite has known-failing tests in CI. Agents using 'zero new failures' baseline see a pre-broken baseline and may mask real regressions.
p1_findings.recommendation: Implement the route OR move tests to pending/ with skip annotations. Do not leave known-failing tests in active CI paths.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses hook rules without rationale
p2_findings.description: eslint-disable comments suppress exhaustive-deps / rules-of-hooks with no explanation. Stale-closure risk present.
p2_findings.recommendation: Document why the suppression is intentional or fix the underlying hook dependency issue.

p2_findings.title: 4 recently-modified frontend files have no tests
p2_findings.description: Recently-modified files with zero test coverage. Violates CLAUDE.md architecture rule: every FR needs a test.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add unit/integration tests for all four components before next release.
